content: KRaft CLUSTER_ID must be a valid base64-encoded UUID (22 chars) and STABLE across restarts. Persisted storage records the cluster id in meta.properties; restarting with a changed CLUSTER_ID (or a stale volume after reformatting) yields INCONSISTENT_CLUSTER_ID error 104 and crash-loops. Reset flow must delete the Kafka log-dir volume together with any CLUSTER_ID change. apache/kafka image formats storage automatically when CLUSTER_ID env provided and log dir empty.
